# Publishing findings to GitHub

## Gate

A reviewer's own configuration may say: **never post comments on pull
requests.** Report findings in conversation; the human decides
what goes on the PR.

Posting therefore requires an explicit instruction for **this** PR. When you get
one:

1. Name the standing rule in one sentence and confirm the override.
2. Confirm the format (all inline / blocking inline + summary body / one issue
   comment).
3. Do not offer to delete the standing rule unless asked.

Confirmation is per-PR. It never carries forward. No `Co-Authored-By`, no
"generated by Claude", no AI attribution anywhere — not in the review body, not
in a comment, not in a commit.

## Before the first write call

Check for an existing pending review. **GitHub allows one pending review per
user per PR**, and a second `POST /pulls/{n}/reviews` fails with a bare 422 that
does not say why.

```bash
gh api /repos/MystenLabs/sui/pulls/<PR>/reviews \
  --jq '.[] | "\(.id) \(.user.login) \(.state) \(.submitted_at)"'
```

A row with `PENDING` and `submitted_at: null` is an unsubmitted draft. Read its
comments before touching it:

```bash
gh api /repos/MystenLabs/sui/pulls/<PR>/reviews/<ID>/comments \
  --jq '.[] | "\(.user.login) \(.created_at) \(.path)\n\(.body)"'
```

It is very likely the reviewer's own draft from an earlier session. **Never delete or
submit it without asking.** Offer: merge into it (their comment publishes first,
usually reads well), submit theirs separately first, or discard theirs. Let them
choose.

## Posting into an existing pending review

The REST API cannot add comments to a pending review. Use GraphQL, which also
preserves the original comment's timestamp and authorship — deleting and
recreating does not.

```bash
gh api /repos/MystenLabs/sui/pulls/<PR>/reviews/<ID> --jq '.node_id'
```

Then `scripts/post-review.js`, which does the whole sequence. It expects a
`review.json` of the shape:

```json
{
  "body": "review summary markdown",
  "event": "COMMENT",
  "comments": [{ "path": "...", "line": 353, "side": "RIGHT", "body": "..." }]
}
```

```bash
node scripts/post-review.js review.json <PR> [pendingReviewNodeId]
```

With a node ID it appends to that pending review and submits it. Without one it
creates a fresh review in a single REST call. It retries with backoff, paces at
1.5s between comments, and writes `add_result.json`.

## Rate limits

Bulk comment creation trips GitHub's **secondary** rate limit, which is separate
from the 5000/hr core limit and reports as a 403 saying "temporarily blocked
from content creation". `gh api rate_limit` will still show thousands remaining
— it does not track the secondary limit.

Pace at ~1.5s between writes. On a 403, back off 5s, 10s, 20s. Do not retry in
a tight loop. If it persists, stop and report rather than hammering.

## Anchoring

`line` is the line in the **new** file with `side: "RIGHT"`. It must be a line
the diff touches — for wholly new files that is any line; for modified files
only added or adjacent context lines. Anchoring outside the diff 422s.

Every anchor gets `grep -n` verified against the fetched file first. Diff line
numbers are not file line numbers.

## Suggestion blocks

Use a ```suggestion block only when the replacement is a **complete, exact**
substitution for the anchored line. Committable suggestions are worth real
effort — they turn a review into a one-click fix.

Good candidates: a heading rewrite, `four` → `4`, a table header row, one added
frontmatter key, an added import line.

Never use one for a multi-line prose rewrite unless you reproduce every line
exactly; a partial suggestion silently deletes surrounding text when committed.
Quote the replacement prose instead.

A suggestion spanning more than the anchored line needs `start_line` plus
`line`, and must reproduce the full range.

## Verify after submitting

```bash
gh api /repos/MystenLabs/sui/pulls/<PR>/comments --paginate --jq '.[].path' \
  | sed 's|.*/||' | sort | uniq -c
gh api /repos/MystenLabs/sui/pulls/<PR>/reviews \
  --jq '.[] | "\(.user.login) \(.state) \(.submitted_at)"'
```

Report the published count, the per-file breakdown, and the review URL. If a
pre-existing draft was merged in, say so and note that the total is your
findings **plus** that comment.

## If something fails partway

Check what actually landed before retrying anything:

```bash
gh api /repos/MystenLabs/sui/pulls/<PR>/comments --jq 'length'
```

Published review comments only appear here after submission; a pending review's
comments do not. A failed create can leave a pending review behind. Never
assume a non-2xx meant nothing happened, and never re-run a bulk post without
checking for duplicates first.
